decisions.reason: As a waterproof lined range close to the core safety-shoe business in a growing market, it likely has manageable carrying costs and enough niche value to keep unless sales have clearly disappointed.

An electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe fits the firm's established technical footwear capabilities and likely serves a durable workplace need, so the option value of keeping it remains high relative to its incremental cost.

A general safety shoe series is strategically close to the core offer and cheap to support on existing platforms, but because it may overlap more with other lines it has a somewhat higher rationalization risk than the more differentiated variants.
